userDirection: Further widen the skill frames and upper-right minimap surround, with richer matched ornamental patterns.
ownership: Project-original deterministic SVG refinement of existing v13/v14 gold family. No generation or external download.
construction: Broad layered metal band; recessed grooves, narrow raised inner/outer lips; embossed acanthus leaves and twin scrolls baked once into the shared SVG texture. Native ornament must not be overlaid for these v15 assets.
sampling: Verified 10-level trilinear mipmapped, non-atlased skill and map textures. Cocos-generated PNG metadata enables mipmaps; UiSkin also initializes fresh single-level engraved textures through the public image setter.
